resumeText:
Aditya Kulkarni | Pune, Maharashtra | aditya.kulkarni.dev@example.com | github.com/adityak-example

EDUCATION
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, Vishwakarma Institute of Engineering and Technology, Pune (2022 - 2026) | CGPA 8.1/10

INTERNSHIP
Android Developer Intern, Sahyadri Grocery Tech, Pune (Jun 2025 - Aug 2025, 10 weeks)
- Fixed UI bugs in the Android app's login, cart and address screens written in Kotlin.
- Added pull-to-refresh and empty states to the order history screen.
- Raised 14 pull requests on GitHub and resolved merge conflicts with the team before each sprint demo.

PROJECTS
- MessMate (personal): Built a Kotlin Android app for tracking hostel mess menus and meal ratings, used by 150 students in my hostel.
- RailBuddy (academic, Mobile Computing course): Fetched live train running status from a public REST API using Retrofit and showed delays on a RecyclerView list.
- Expense Splitter (hackathon, Smart India Hackathon internal round): Built an Android app with Room database to split hostel trip expenses among friends.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Data Structures, Object Oriented Programming, DBMS, Operating Systems, Mobile Computing
- Android Basics with Compose (Google, online course)

SKILLS
Kotlin, Java, Android SDK, Jetpack libraries, MVVM, Retrofit, Room, Git, Firebase basics, XML layouts

ACTIVITIES
- Core member, Google Developer Student Club, ran an Android study jam for 60 juniors
- College football team
